title: Causal relationship, shared genes between rheumatoid arthritis and pulp and periapical disease: evidence from GWAS and transcriptome data.
authors: Wu, Huili; Wang, Lijuan; Qiu, Chenjie
one_liner_zh: 该文基于GWAS和转录组数据研究类风湿关节炎与牙髓根尖周病的因果关系及共享基因，虽涉及转录因子调控网络构建，但核心为疾病关联与诊断标志物，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) have an increased risk of developing pulp and periapical disease (PAP), but the causal relationship and shared genetic factors between these conditions have not been explored. This study aimed to investigate the bidirectional causal relationship between RA and PAP and to analyze shared genes and pathogenic pathways. METHODS: We utilized GWAS data from the IEU Open GWAS Project and employed five Mendelian randomization methods (MR Egger, weighted median, inverse variance weighted, simple mode, and weighted mode) to investigate the bidirectional causal relationship between RA and PAP. Transcriptome data for RA and irreversible pulpitis (IRP) were obtained from the GEO database. Hub genes were identified through differential analysis, CytoHubba, machine learning (ML), and other methods. The immune infiltration of both diseases was analyzed using the ssGSEA method. Finally, we constructed a regulatory network for miRNAs, transcription factors, chemicals, diseases, and RNA-binding proteins based on the identified hub genes. RESULTS: RA was significantly associated with an increased risk of PAP (OR = 1.1284, 95% CI 1.0674-1.1929, p < 0.001). However, there was insufficient evidence to support the hypothesis that PAP increased the risk of RA. Integrating datasets and differential analysis identified 84 shared genes primarily involved in immune and inflammatory pathways, including the IL-17 signaling pathway, Th17 cell differentiation, and TNF signaling pathway. Using CytoHubba and three ML methods, we identified three hub genes (HLA-DRA, ITGAX, and PTPRC) that are significantly correlated and valuable for diagnosing RA and IRP. We then constructed a comprehensive regulatory network using the miRDB, miRWalk, ChipBase, hTFtarget, CTD, MalaCards, DisGeNET, and ENCORI databases. CONCLUSION: RA may increase the risk of PAP. The three key genes, HLA-DRA, ITGAX, and PTPRC, have significant diagnostic value for both RA and IRP.
abstract_zh: 目的：类风湿关节炎（RA）患者发生牙髓及根尖周疾病（PAP）的风险增加，但两者之间的因果关系及共享遗传因素尚未被探讨。本研究旨在探究RA与PAP之间的双向因果关系，并分析共享基因及致病通路。方法：我们利用来自IEU Open GWAS项目的GWAS数据，并采用五种孟德尔随机化方法（MR Egger、加权中位数、逆方差加权、简单模式及加权模式）来研究RA与PAP之间的双向因果关系。RA和不可逆性牙髓炎（IRP）的转录组数据来自GEO数据库。通过差异分析、CytoHubba、机器学习（ML）等方法鉴定核心基因。使用ssGSEA方法分析两种疾病的免疫浸润情况。最后，我们基于鉴定的核心基因构建了miRNA、转录因子、化学物质、疾病及RNA结合蛋白的调控网络。结果：RA与PAP风险增加显著相关（OR = 1.1284，95% CI 1.0674-1.1929，p < 0.001）。然而，没有足够证据支持PAP增加RA风险的假设。整合数据集和差异分析识别出84个共享基因，主要涉及免疫和炎症通路，包括IL-17信号通路、Th17细胞分化及TNF信号通路。利用CytoHubba和三种ML方法，我们鉴定出三个核心基因（HLA-DRA、ITGAX和PTPRC），这些基因显著相关，并对RA和IRP的诊断具有价值。随后，我们利用miRDB、miRWalk、ChipBase、hTFtarget、CTD、MalaCards、DisGeNET和ENCORI数据库构建了综合调控网络。结论：RA可能增加PAP的风险。三个关键基因HLA-DRA、ITGAX和PTPRC对RA和IRP均具有显著的诊断价值。
